issue.body:
Title: Static files and admin panel assets not loading correctly behind a proxy with root_path in FastAPI

Description:

I’m running a FastAPI application behind a reverse proxy (Nginx) and have configured root_path in the FastAPI app as described in the official documentation:
https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/behind-a-proxy/

However, static files (e.g., CSS, JS) and possibly other paths are not resolving correctly.

I’m using starlette-admin, and the admin panel attempts to load assets using paths like:
`<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ url_for(__name__ ~ ':statics', path='css/tabler.min.css') }}">`

My FastAPI setup:
```
app = FastAPI(
    version="0.0.1",
    prefix="/api/",
    root_path="/api/",
    root_path_in_servers=False,
    lifespan=lifespan 
           )

admin = Admin(title = 'Code.❤️ Admin',
                templates_dir="admin_templates/templates",
                statics_dir="admin_templates/statics",
                auth_provider=MyAuthProvider(),
              )
```

These static paths return 404 errors. I’ve tried the following without success:
	•	Serving static files manually via FastAPI routes
	•	Setting up separate static file routing in Nginx
	•	Confirming that root_path correctly prepends /api to URLs
	•	Rewriting asset paths using Nginx and directly injecting correct URLs

Despite all of this, the admin panel fails to load any static assets and cannot function beyond the initial page. I cannot navigate to sub-pages, and CSS/JS files do not load.

Example errors:
`INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/users/list HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/statics/css/tabler.min.css HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/statics/css/fontawesome.min.css HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/statics/js/vendor/jquery.min.js HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/statics/js/vendor/js.cookie.min.js HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
INFO:     185.215.54.133:0 - "GET /admin/statics/js/vendor/tabler.min.js HTTP/1.0" 404 Not Found
`

Additionally, without setting root_path, Swagger UI does not work behind a proxy — which is already a critical issue on its own.
